name: This_14
short_caption: The robot extends its left hand forward, palm facing up, to offer or indicate something.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture. It then raises its left arm, turning the palm upward and extending it slightly outward toward the listener. It holds this open-handed gesture briefly before smoothly bringing the arm back down to its side, returning to the neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The left arm extends forward and slightly outward; ensure there are no obstacles immediately to the front-left of the robot's chest level.
